capabilities: Reorder status bar elements via drag and drop
Hide or show individual status bar elements
Create and switch between status bar presets
Remember separate presets for fullscreen and windowed modes
extras: The Gallery section in the README contains no content beyond the heading; deleted plugins' status bar entries remain listed until manually removed with a trash can button.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to rearrange status bar elements or hide unwanted ones.
summary: Settings-based tool that lets you reorder, hide, and show status bar elements, with multiple switchable presets.
